subject: Embedded Systems Engineer — interview feedback & next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Feedback request — Aisha Ramanathan (Embedded Systems)

Hi team,

Thanks for interviewing Aisha this week. I attached her resume for reference. Quick ask: can each of you drop your high-level impressions + a 1–10 score on the rubric by EOD Friday (6/19)? We need to decide whether to move to a design deep dive or pass.

Key areas we were assessing: low-level firmware experience, constrained-resource algorithm design, telemetry/debugging approaches, and culture fit.

Attachments: Aisha_Ramanathan_Resume.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn.hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, monica.patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feedback request — Aisha Ramanathan (Embedded Systems)

Quick notes (TL;DR: +1 to continue to design deep dive)

Score: 8/10
Pros:
- Strong understanding of memory-constrained scheduling and DMA usage. Gave concrete examples of latency tradeoffs on a previous product.
- Clear mental model for deterministic interrupt handling.
- Good debugging discipline (JTAG, core dumps) and instrumentation suggestions.

Concerns:
- Limited exposure to custom silicon bringup (mostly worked on off-the-shelf MCUs). Could be a blocker for some firmware work on our new accelerator.

Recommendation: Proceed to a 90-minute design deep dive (hardware-software handshake + bringup plan).

Attachment: marcus_lin_feedback.pdf
Marcus Lin | Staff Engineer, Systems

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn.hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, monica.patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feedback request — Aisha Ramanathan (Embedded Systems)

Agree with Marcus — overall positive. Score: 7/10.
- Very solid at constrained systems software.
- Culture fit was good; asked thoughtful questions about our monitoring/rollout practices.

I support the deep dive. If we ask the engineering panel to focus on bringup on day 1, it should reveal whether the custom-silicon gap is critical.

Laura Bennett | Eng Manager, Firmware

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn.hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feedback request — Aisha Ramanathan (Embedded Systems)

Score: 6/10 — leaning cautious.

Notes (see attached panel spreadsheet for itemized rubric):
- Positive: clear testing hygiene and telemetry thinking.
- Concern: lacked examples of hardware bringup automation and device tree workflows we rely on.
- Would like to see a sample of prior bringup checklists or a quick design doc before committing.

Recommendation: If we move forward, include a short prework doc for the candidate to prepare (1–2 pages) and a panel member (Marcus or Laura) to probe custom-silicon scenarios.

Attachments: monica_patel_panel_notes.xlsx
Monica Patel | Senior PM, Platform

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, evelyn.hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, marcus.lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, monica.patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feedback request — Aisha Ramanathan (Embedded Systems)

Short take: 4/10 — I had trouble getting concrete examples of custom silicon bringup. Felt more firmware-on-MCU than bringup engineer.

If we have a strong hiring need in pure firmware, she could fit; for our accelerator bringup path I think we'd need someone with demonstrable board bringup and cross-domain debugging.

Mina

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Feedback request — Aisha Ramanathan (Embedded Systems)

Team — thanks for the quick turn. Summary below and suggested next step:

Summary:
- Scores: Marcus 8, Laura 7, Monica 6, Mina 4. (Average: 6.25)
- Consensus: interest in continuing the process, but flags around custom-silicon bringup experience.
- Risk: candidate may require pairing with a senior bringup engineer for the first 6 months.

Suggested next step: run a 90-minute design deep dive focused on "bringup + hardware handshake" where we include one concrete prework prompt (see Drive link) and ask the candidate to outline a short bringup checklist and failure triage plan. Marcus or Laura should lead the probe. If the deep dive reveals satisfactory hands-on bringup intuition we can extend an offer; otherwise we close.

Please reply if you disagree with that approach. Priyom — can you coordinate scheduling and send the prework doc to Aisha? If we keep to the timeline, aim to have the deep dive next week (6/23–6/25). I'll draft a short debrief summary for the hiring packet and attach it once it's done.

Attachment: debrief-summary-Aisha-20260620.pdf

Evelyn Hart | Director, Systems Engineering
Redwood Inference
